answer: With k coordinated identities, correlated equivocation exposes up to k(k−1)/2 culpable pairs, so penalties scale as O(k²), not as isolated single-node fines. Detection triggers slashing from bonded escrows and asymmetric depreciation that compounds across linked claims, imposing an exponential multiplier on total capital loss. Whether the swarm labels itself walnut, willow, or quartz, splitting control among sybils does not dilute correlated evidence or reduce liability.
